status.description:
A string representing the status of the stored app information.

  - `CREATED`: The app information was successfully stored.
  - `UPDATED`: App information for the same root package and `major.minor.patch` already
    existed, so it was overwritten.
  - `OUTDATED`: App information for the same root package and `major.minor.patch` already
    exists and has a higher full {@link SemanticVersion} than the current app, so no
    change was made.

appInfo.description:
If #status is `CREATED` or `UPDATED`, this field contains the `.zip` of the collected
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.AppInfo}.
